searchQueries.title: Search Queries
searchQueries.description: IT job search terms (e.g., 'Software Entwickler', 'DevOps Engineer', 'Java Entwickler')

postalCodeFilter.title: Postal Code Filter (PLZ)
postalCodeFilter.description: Filter jobs by postal code prefix. E.g., ['5'] for Köln/Bonn region (50xxx-59xxx), ['50', '53'] for Köln and Bonn specifically

jobPortals.title: Job Portals
jobPortals.description: Which job portals to scrape. Options: 'all', 'google', 'stepstone', 'indeed'

maxResults.title: Max Results per Portal/Query
maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to scrape per portal and search query

includeRemote.title: Include Remote Positions
includeRemote.description: Include remote/home office positions in results

excludeWords.title: Exclude Words
excludeWords.description: Job titles containing these words will be filtered out (e.g., 'Praktikum', 'Werkstudent')

excludeRecruitmentAgencies.title: Exclude Recruitment Agencies
excludeRecruitmentAgencies.description: Automatically filter out jobs from Personalvermittlung, Personalberatung, Headhunters, and Zeitarbeit firms

maxJobAgeDays.title: Max Job Age (Days)
maxJobAgeDays.description: Only include jobs posted within the last N days (default: 90 days)

enableContactEnrichment.title: Enable Contact Enrichment
enableContactEnrichment.description: Automatically research and extract contact information (names, emails, phones) for IT managers and HR decision-makers. Processes 5 companies in parallel for faster performance.

maxContactsPerCompany.title: Max Contacts per Company
maxContactsPerCompany.description: Maximum number of contact persons to research per company (IT managers and HR decision-makers)

maxRetries.title: Max Retries
maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for failed requests

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy or custom proxy configuration. Recommended for production runs.

minDelayBetweenRequests.title: Min Delay Between Requests
minDelayBetweenRequests.description: Minimum delay between requests in milliseconds

maxDelayBetweenRequests.title: Max Delay Between Requests
maxDelayBetweenRequests.description: Maximum delay between requests in milliseconds
